caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical metallic object placed centrally on a plain, beige background. The object appears to be an industrial or mechanical component, possibly a flange or a wheel hub. It is rendered in tones of gray and blue, with the blue accentuating the outer edges and decorative lines around the cylinder. The surface of the cylinder features several bands of raised dots and lines arranged concentrically, and there are three circular holes evenly spaced on its top face, along with a larger central circular opening. Inscribed along the side of the cylinder is the text "GEO. CRAWFORD." The drawing is signed "JOHN TARANTINO" in small text at the bottom right corner of the background. The illustration is centered with wide margins of unadorned beige space surrounding the object.
title: Inkwell
